basics.description: pbiplint, hosted privately in your own Azure network: a storage account serving the site as a static website, reachable only through private endpoints on a subnet you already run. This creates the infrastructure; you upload the site's files afterwards with the commands on https://pbiplint.com/self-host/.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Region for the storage account. The private endpoints go in your virtual network's own region.

basics.name: storageAccountName
basics.label: Storage account name
basics.toolTip: 3 to 24 lowercase letters and digits, unique across Azure. It becomes part of the site's address.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 3 to 24 lowercase letters and digits.

options.text: Pick a virtual network and subnet you already run; it may be in another resource group. Creating the private endpoints needs permission to join that subnet (Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/subnets/join/action).

elements.name: subnet
elements.label: Subnet
elements.toolTip: The subnet the two private endpoints join.

elements.name: dnsMode
elements.label: Private DNS records
elements.defaultValue: Create the two privatelink zones here
elements.toolTip: A virtual network cannot link two zones of the same name, so a network already linked to central privatelink zones needs one of the other two choices.

allowedValues.label: Create the two privatelink zones here
None: our Azure Policy writes the records

options.text: Choose this only for a network that uses Azure-provided DNS: zones answer only queries that reach Azure DNS, so a network with its own DNS servers (a hub forwarder, say) or clients on premises need the existing zones or your own policy instead. Linking the new zones to the network needs permission to join it (Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/join/action).

Both zones are required: privatelink.web.core.windows.net in the first box and privatelink.blob.core.windows.net in the second. Adding records to them needs permission to join them (Microsoft.Network/privateDnsZones/join/action).

elements.name: workspace
elements.label: Log Analytics workspace (optional)
elements.toolTip: Receives every write and delete of the site's files, so any change to them shows up. Leave empty to send none.

elements.name: writeGroupObjectId
elements.label: Entra group that may change the site's files (optional)
elements.toolTip: The object ID of one Entra group. Its members get Storage Blob Data Contributor on the site's $web container and nothing else. Leave empty to assign nothing.

options.text: Creating the delete lock, and assigning the group's role, need Owner, or Contributor together with User Access Administrator, on this resource group. Contributor alone cannot create the lock. Left empty, the group can be assigned later by whoever holds either role.
